title: Counting Electrocardiogram Tracings for Payment — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Training note, answered as questions.** The tracing code 93005 under revenue code 0730 on an Observation Stay Account or Emergency Department Visit Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) is read by its billed units and its number of lines when its retained value is figured on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing).

*How many tracings are counted?*
- **Commercial HMO Claim:** one per line of code 93005 (serial tracings on one line are paid once).
- **Commercial PPO Claim:** its counted units, but no more than 3 times its number of lines.
- **Otherwise (a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim):** its counted units.

Its counted units are its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

*How is each counted tracing valued?* At its charges per counted unit times the payer class's expected allowed percentage, never above its charges.

*Worked case (hypothetical: 2 lines, 8 billed units, charges 400.00, payer class modeled at 50%).* Charges per counted unit: 50.00, at 50% → 25.00 per tracing.
| Payer class | Tracings counted | Value |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial HMO Claim | 2 | 50.00 |
| Commercial PPO Claim | 6 (8 units, at most 3 times 2 lines) | 150.00 |
| Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim | 8 | 200.00 |
